d:
MLC chunav parinam ke bad jadyu ke andar darar barhti ja rahi hai. niraj kumar ne aaj lalan sinh ke khilaph khulkar bayan diya. chetavni dete hue kaha ki chunav ke dauran jisne bhi mujhe mansik rup se pareshan kiya hai unhen karj ke sath chukaunga. dekhiye ye riport
About Channel:
ABP Bihar pradesh ki khabron ka ek aisa chainal hai jahan pradesh se juri har khabar aapke pas sabse pahle pahunchti hai. bihar ki rajniti, bihar ki barh, lalu - nitish ka ek dusre par palatvar, apradh ki andruni khabar aapke pas tathyon ke sath lekar aata hai.
